title: Ben Zaza

paragraphs: (“And of the sons of Yonatan: Pelet and Zaza,” I Chronicles 20:33.) He is mentioned in [Rosh Hashanah 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.25a.11): when Ben Zaza’s mother died, Rabban Gamliel delivered a great eulogy for her — not because she deserved it, but so that the people would know that the court had not sanctified the month.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman cites I Chronicles 20:33 for the opening quotation. It appears in [I Chronicles 2:33](https://www.sefaria.org/I_Chronicles.2.33). [Heilprin’s Zaza entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1110&lang=en) records the eulogy in the linked Bavli passage.
